text: In August 2014, City Council adopted Official Plan Amendment 246, called Bathurst Street - Queen Street West to Dupont Street ("OPA 246"). The OPA was appealed by two parties, Torgan Management Inc. in respect of its property at 844 Bathurst Street and University Health Network (“UHN”) in respect of the Toronto Western Hospital property, located at 399 Bathurst Street. The purpose of this report is to seek instruction for the LPAT appeal by the UHN. No LPAT hearing has been scheduled yet.

City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 2, 2021) from the City Solicitor remain confidential.
